question: 四年中世界对中国经济的依存度的平均值是多少?

steps.description: Identify that black bars in the chart represent world dependence on China's economy
Read the value from the black bar corresponding to year 2000
Read the value from the black bar corresponding to year 2007
Read the value from the black bar corresponding to year 2012
Read the value from the black bar corresponding to year 2017
Sum the four values obtained from steps 2 through 5
Divide the sum from step 6 by 4 to calculate the average
